reading.action: Detach the winding-drum core from the chain, hold it and spin in place, trying to connect to the stored essence within and pull it into himself.
reading.result: STORED-FORCE FIRST DRAW -- ruling (C) (iris-prep): CONTACT ticks, flesh-HOUSING fails, the failure teaches. He DETACHED the core (dervish-flail mode dropped) and spun his OWN body holding it, reaching a motion-essence through MOTION -- a valid, thematically-correct contact vector (vs t79's incidental flail torque-tell). INT 20 + intent 5 + bias 0 + roll 11 = 36 vs DC 17 -> margin 19: CONTACT guaranteed (the vector earns it; roll scales only backlash). Force Affinity EMERGES 0->1 (counter 1/10 toward Force Manipulation). His DESTINATION (pull it into MYSELF) FAILED BY RULE -- stored-force will not set in single-pole ember flesh (Ember-Tempered Body sink-not-source; t62 cold-into-flesh NO, reaffirmed); he drew it but retained nothing, it sluiced through and out. BACKLASH (typical band, stamina + recoil-stagger, NO HP-burn): stamina 66->54 (-12), focus 90->82 (-8), a real stagger + spin-dizziness, kept his feet. TAUGHT: the essence is reachable, the BODY is the wrong vessel -- bind it into an EXTERNAL ember-housed vessel (the core itself), not pull it into himself. ANTI-FARM: one-time emergence; re-spinning the failed into-flesh method does NOT re-tick. system_card FIRES -> AFFINITY -- Force Affinity (generator's maiden real ding). DETACH clean (core standalone, maul atk 10, inv 7). HELD DARK: tier ladder / deeper capability / thresholds / vessel mechanics. Ch5 OPEN. NO Tower reset.
